mapper.select: SELECT MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(payment_no, 11) AS UNSIGNED)) FROM biz_payment_request WHERE payment_no LIKE CONCAT('FK', DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d'), '%')

SELECT dept_name, SUM(amount) as total_amount, COUNT(*) as payment_count FROM biz_payment_request WHERE DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = #{month} AND status IN ('APPROVED', 'PAID') AND deleted = '0' GROUP BY dept_name ORDER BY total_amount DESC
